      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • dimFactor

      public WaveText.Builder dimFactor(double dimFactor)
      Sets the dim factor for the wave effect.

      A value of 0.0 means completely black, 1.0 means no dimming. Default is 0.3.

      Parameters:
      dimFactor - the dim factor (0.0-1.0)
      Returns:
      this builder

    • peakWidth

      public WaveText.Builder peakWidth(int peakWidth)
      Sets the width of the wave peak in characters.

      Larger values create a wider wave area. Default is 3.

      Parameters:
      peakWidth - the peak width
      Returns:
      this builder

    • peakCount

      public WaveText.Builder peakCount(int peakCount)
      Sets the number of peaks in the wave.

      Multiple peaks create a more dynamic effect. Default is 1.

      Parameters:
      peakCount - the number of peaks
      Returns:
      this builder

    • speed

      public WaveText.Builder speed(double speed)
      Sets the animation speed multiplier.

      Values greater than 1.0 speed up the animation, values less than 1.0 slow it down. Default is 1.0.

      Parameters:
      speed - the speed multiplier
      Returns:
      this builder

    • styleResolver

      public WaveText.Builder styleResolver(StylePropertyResolver resolver)
      Sets the property resolver for style-aware properties.

      When set, properties like color, wave-dim-factor, wave-peak-width, wave-peak-count, and wave-speed will be resolved from the styling system if not set programmatically.

      Parameters:
      resolver - the property resolver
      Returns:
      this builder

    • mode

      public WaveText.Builder mode(WaveText.Mode mode)
      Sets the animation mode.

      WaveText.Mode.LOOP creates continuous movement in one direction. WaveText.Mode.OSCILLATE creates back-and-forth movement. Default is LOOP.

      Parameters:
      mode - the animation mode
      Returns:
      this builder

    • oscillate

      public WaveText.Builder oscillate()
      Sets the wave to oscillate back and forth.

      Shorthand for mode(Mode.OSCILLATE).

      Returns:
      this builder

    • inverted

      public WaveText.Builder inverted(boolean inverted)
      Sets whether the effect is inverted.

      When false (default), a dark shadow moves through bright text. When true, a bright peak moves through dim text.

      Parameters:
      inverted - true to invert the effect
      Returns:
      this builder

    • style

      public WaveText.Builder style(Style style)
      Sets the base style (modifiers like bold, italic).

      The foreground color will be overridden by the wave effect.

      Parameters:
      style - the base style
      Returns:
      this builder
